families.name: LETF close flow H1
families.note: Primary effect: on active days the mean signed return tau -> close is positive (§4 H1; Holm across the 6 primary cells)

families.name: shock classifier H1
families.note: Class divergence: INFO and LIQ returns differ in the shock direction (§6 H1; Holm across the 4 instruments)

families.name: ledger H2
families.note: Price effect: signed return from the t0+1 fill to the W_end close on traded days (§9 H2; Holm across the 2 instruments)

families.name: index H-R1
families.note: Execution-day effect: signed entry -> W_end close return pooled across commodities, days and years (§6 H-R1; Holm across constructions A and B)

families.name: index H-R2
families.note: Reversal: signed return in the reversal direction over 1/3/5 days (§6 H-R2; Holm across 3 holds x 2 constructions)

families.name: index H-R3(b)
families.note: Pre-positioning, TRADING arm only: the December entry -> pre-execution exit return in the forecast direction (§6 H-R3(b); H-R3(a) is descriptive and is not a decision family)

families.name: opening H-O2
families.note: Decision value: the state-conditioned policy's net daily return minus the best of B1-B3, paired by day (§7 H-O2; Holm across t0 in {09:45, 10:00})
